description: Election Commission - Notify the appointment of Mr. S. Kuhawaradan to the Western Province Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Western Province Provincial Council through the electoral process. It references the Provincial Councils Elections Act, involves the Election Commission, and declares the election of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by resignation. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
